title: Endogenous H2-Conditioned ER History as a Persistent Route-Ready Fabric
status: GEOMETRY-FIRST ENDOGENOUS ROUTE-FABRIC TEST / NOT PHYSICAL DARK-MATTER WITNESS

construction.route_ready_support: co-support of adjacency memory, corridor memory, and persistent memory
construction.thresholding: same normalized threshold applied to all three fields; normalization uses joint fresh/conditioned maximum per field

ruling: The endogenous H2-conditioned ER history generates a connected 3D co-support fabric in adjacency+corridor+persistence memory over a finite threshold interval where the fresh environment has no comparable route-ready fabric. This supplies an endogenous geometric bridge between ER history and the Rainbow-Bus route-family interpretation.
boundary: The co-support rule is a work-layer route-readiness diagnostic; it is not a canonical Rainbow Road or Portal transaction law and is not an Invariant Residue identification.
